task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a conditional with the no-timing cue "must also", which matches RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open). texts: If the agent picks up the key (has_door_key), the door must also be opened at some point, before, with, or after that moment.
